exposure: Women with one previous cesarean section
Women achieving their first vaginal birth after cesarean section (first VBAC group)
outcome: Rate of third and fourth degree perineal tears
cohort: Women with singleton pregnancies at term who delivered vaginally
finding: There was no significant difference in the rate of severe perineal injuries between women who had a vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC) and nulliparous women who delivered vaginally.
mod_finding: This study compared rates of severe perineal injuries in women who delivered vaginally after a previous cesarean section (VBAC) to those who delivered vaginally for the first time and found no significant difference.
